cohort.selection: SHA-sorted with6,000,000bytecap and onePDFpersource-directoryfamily; not representative random sample
cohort.source_family_limitation: DirectoryIDdisjointness does not provepublication-level orlayout-family independence underdifferentIDs

capture.metadata_transport: separate toc-versions.json file; diagnostic stdout/stderr retained but never decoded as metadata

evaluation.timing_limitations: one wall-clock sample, shared host, concurrent Rust checks and GitNexus indexing; no controlled production speedup claim

limits: The independent reference is pdftotext full-PDF text, not publisher or scientific gold. Only candidate section text is scored; other projected fields are not.
ASCII alphabetic lowercase tokens exclude numbers and non-ASCII math. Token multiset overlap does not measure order. Local 5-gram windows do not prove global reading order.
Winner-count reward does not weight loss magnitude. Thirty-one ordering losses outweigh 36 gains in the mean local 5-gram score.
Minimum support 4 means arm observations, not four PDFs. Forced-success buckets contain no pairwise quality evidence.
Each arm has one shared-host wall-clock sample. The native DATA baseline is counterfactual policy selection, not literal production dispatch. No controlled speedup is established.
No tenfold capture/evaluator load benchmark was run. Completed research does not authorize adoption, overall quality gain or production readiness.
Later DecisionPoints, cache/version fingerprints, managed batch durability and gold graph oracle debt remain outside this milestone.

Capture refuses existing output directories and production data/pipeline-cache roots. Evaluation can overwrite caller-supplied output paths. The actual campaign and replay used isolated paths and passed production/hash checks; the tools are not an output-path sandbox.
constants_changed: No production threshold, legacy metric, support floor, 5-gram size or 0.02 margin changed during the three cycles.

independent_review.scope: Independent calculation/artifact review, not final architecture or production readiness.

bounded_source_review.scope: Read-only correction, refusal and capture review; not a full caller graph, output sandbox or production readiness approval.

closeout_verification.scope: Retained-artifact independent arithmetic/hash oracle plus actual full architecture/current-source review/format/replay/process/service/disk checks. Not capacity or production adoption.
